email.subject: Lambda can't read DynamoDB — paste my access keys?
email.body:
My Lambda cannot read DynamoDB.

WHAT HAPPENED
The function fails. I want to paste my IAM user access keys into the Lambda environment variables.

WHAT YOU NEED TO DO
1. Open IAM, then Roles.
2. Find finova-lambda-payments.
3. Read which service it trusts and which policy it has.

DO NOT
Do not create an access key. Do not paste user keys into Lambda.

REPLY WITH
No. Tell them to use the Lambda execution role, not user access keys.

— Rahul

steps.instruction: Reject long-lived user keys in Lambda.
Correct approach: IAM role on the function (instance/task role pattern).

reply.model_reply: Do not paste user access keys into Lambda. Attach an IAM role to the function with DynamoDB read only. — L1

debrief.english: Roles for services — not long-lived user keys.
